activity_summary: On the way back you read the Rose's bill on a post. It was A Knack to Know an Honest Man. The bill named no author and no price. You did not go to the Rose.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the title, and walked on.

entities.context: Mentioned in A Knack, on the post
